added.content: Damon worked through his losing line in the London System with Rhea move by move — kingside setup he wasn't using, the c3 response to early c5, Qb3 against Qb6 — and landed on a real realization about his own play: he's better in endgames than middlegames, so trading queens into an endgame is his actual plan, not the kingside attack ("huh. yeah. that's actually the thing"). Committed to trying the kingside plan for ten games to test it against his fear of being punished for playing too aggressively. [sess-2026-10-14_3a4b5c6d:4-63]
